variables.user_request:
Start a workflow-authoring workflow to update the work-package and meta workflows so the monorepo host-repo binding is DERIVED FROM GIT instead of inferred from prose.

Motivation: a session bound to midnightntwrk/midnight-node (taken from a PR URL) mapped through the server's basename-only multi-root mapping to /home/mike1/projects/dev/midnight-node/.engineering and silently created an empty, non-git directory. The real checkout is a submodule of the shieldedtech/midnight-agent-eng superproject at dev/midnight-agent-eng/midnight-node, so the commit+push hook had no repo and the reviewer had no source. The workflow already owns monorepo detection but runs it AFTER the binding is committed, and it answers a different question (which component, not which host repo).

Fixes to author:

1. New technique version-control::resolve-host-repo, run in meta 00-discover-session before the transition to initialize-session. Protocol: git rev-parse --show-toplevel from the workspace cwd; ascend while the parent directory is itself a git repo whose .gitmodules lists the current basename as a submodule path (outermost superproject wins — this generalizes work-package repo-root-resolution.md's existing single-level test and moves it to where it can gate the binding); derive owner/repo from that host's origin remote. Outputs: target_repo, host_repo_path, is_monorepo_host, and component_hint (the innermost toplevel's basename when we ascended — a better component signal than a URL, feeding select-target-component's pre-selection). Assert basename(host_repo_path) == basename(target_repo), because the server's multi-root mapping is basename-only; a mismatch raises a checkpoint rather than diverging silently.

2. Add mentioned_repo (from PR/issue URLs) to workflow-engine::extract-identifying-context and route it to version-control::select-target-component as component context only. State the invariant once in version-control::TECHNIQUE.md beside infrastructure-submodule-paths: a repo named in the request identifies the COMPONENT; the host binding is derived from git; they are never the same variable.

3. Retire the prose sources: meta/resources/bootstrap-protocol.md step 2 and workflow-engine/start-session.md's repo input currently say the repo comes from workspace AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md or the user. Rewrite both to derive via resolve-host-repo, with AGENTS.md/user demoted to fallback for when the workspace is not a git repo or has no origin remote.

4. Close the loop in meta 02-resolve-target: add a validation that the repo_root resolved by work-package repo-root-resolution is the same directory the session bound, so a bad binding fails at activity 02 before artifacts exist. This also catches a resume carrying a stale saved binding, which resolve-host-repo alone will not.

5. Fix two latent defects in the same seam: (a) meta's target_path ("submodule path for monorepos", default ".") collides by name with work-package's target_path ("feature worktree path for edits"), which is overwritten by compute-canonical-target-path at step 570 and is safe only because resolve-repo-root happens to sit at step 159 — rename meta's output to component_path; (b) work-package repo-root-resolution's discovered_path input is never bound by anything and specifies an absolute path while meta's target_path defaults to relative "." — bind it explicitly from component_path, absolutized against host_repo_path.

All edited files live in the workflows submodule (branch: workflows). Touching the meta activities will likely require re-baselining the walk snapshots.
